en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Washa, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>
having said: ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘The supplication repels the affliction, the descended one and what has not descended yet’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Washsha’ from abu al-Hassan (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s.) has said, ‘Prayer and pleading before Allah for help, repels the misfortune that has already come down and that which has not yet come down.’”
